# THW Coaching (The Hybrid Way)

> Application de coaching sportif par IA pour athlètes hybrides (endurance et force), et Decaform, un test physique sur 1000 points qui mesure sept qualités physiques pour tous les âges.

## Pages principales
- [THW Coaching — AI coaching for hybrid athletes](https://www.the-hybridway.com/): Endurance and strength in one app: AI coach, training plans, performance analysis, nutrition and recovery. 14-day free trial, no credit card.
- [Les tests Decaform](https://www.the-hybridway.com/tests.html): Tous les tests Decaform : enfants, ados, adultes et seniors. Un score sur 1000, sept qualités physiques, des épreuves adaptées à chaque âge.
- [Decaform — le test physique](https://www.the-hybridway.com/cadences.html): Decaform : un test physique complet, un score sur 1000 et un niveau par qualité, en barème général ou ajusté à l'âge. Des batteries dédiées par âge (enfants, ados, adultes, seniors).
- [Features](https://www.the-hybridway.com/theme.html): Explore a THW Coaching feature in detail — your hybrid training driven by an AI that knows you.
- [The THW Coaching app — AI coaching for hybrid athletes](https://www.the-hybridway.com/app.html): Discover the THW Coaching app: AI coach, training plans, performance analysis, nutrition and recovery for endurance and strength athletes.
- [Plans and pricing](https://www.the-hybridway.com/abonnement-athlete.html): Premium, Pro or Expert: pick the plan that matches your ambition. 14-day free trial, no credit card, cancel anytime.
- [Coach plans](https://www.the-hybridway.com/abonnement-coach.html): Coach 10 to 500 athletes. Every coaching feature is in every pack — you pay for capacity, not for features. 14-day free trial.
- [Support — Hybrid (THW Coaching)](https://www.the-hybridway.com/support.html): Support Hybrid / THW Coaching : contact, aide et réponses aux questions fréquentes. Support Hybrid: contact, help and answers to frequent questions.
